walkthrough.short: Circle round {pairs} without turning round: one in front, one behind, facing the same way throughout.
walkthrough.long: Keep facing exactly the way you are facing now — that is the whole figure. Now travel: one of you slides across in front of {pairs} and the other goes behind, so the two of you go round the point between you as though it were a small circle. You are walking sideways and backwards past somebody while still looking where you were looking. Nobody takes hands. {where}

walkthrough.short: Circle all the way round {pairs} without turning round, and come back to your own place.
